liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Tennessee Jed** (1 review): First-set Tennessee Jed is good, though the first set overall is rated fairly average [9]
- **Not Fade Away** (1 review): Second-set Not Fade Away runs over fifteen minutes and features John Cipollina, described as outstanding [9]

## The recordings

- **gd79-05-07.glassberg.vernon.18877.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 20 songs; 183 min; rated 4.05/5 by 20 [1]
- **gd1979-05-07.177536.nak700.glassberg.menke.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 20 songs; 185 min [2]
- **gd1979-05-07.177532.nak700.glassberg.menke.miller.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 20 songs; 185 min [3]
- **gd1979-05-07.139635.aud.unk.flac1644**: audience recording; 20 songs; 179 min [4]

## Around the show

- The next night's Penn State show may edge this one out, but this show remains very listenable [9]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd79-05-07.glassberg.vernon.18877.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Barry Glassberg; transferred by John Steinthal; source: Audience Recording [1]
- **gd1979-05-07.177536.nak700.glassberg.menke.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Barry Glassberg; transferred by Bob Menke, Charlie Miller, Scott Clugston; source: Barry Glassberg's Master Audience Cassettes: Nakamichi 700 mics > Sony TC-158SD (Maxell UDXL II) [2]
- **gd1979-05-07.177532.nak700.glassberg.menke.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Barry Glassberg; transferred by Bob Menke, Charlie Miller, Scott Clugston; source: Barry Glassberg's Master Audience Cassettes: Nakamichi 700 mics > Sony TC-158SD (Maxell UDXL II) [3]
- **gd1979-05-07.139635.aud.unk.flac1644**: taped by Unknown via Craig L.; transferred by Andrew F.; source: AUD: Unknown taper & gear > Low-gen tapes, kindly provided from the collection of Craig L. [4]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by SoundCloud: [Passenger (Live at Allen Kirby Field House, Lafayette College, Easton PA, 5/7/79)](https://soundcloud.com/gratefuldead/passenger-live-at-allen-kirby) [22]
- Poster by Marsia Tunis Grateful Dead: [1979-05-07 Allan Kirby Field House, Lafayette College, Easton, PA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1979-05-07-allan-kirby-field-house-lafayette-college-easton-pa-usa/) [23]
- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Kirby Fieldhouse - May 7, 1979](https://www.dead.net/show/may-7-1979) [24]
- Poster by Amy Downey: [Marquis lineup](https://magazine.lafayette.edu/marquis-lineup/) [25]
